_about: v17o: published values for main tests and cross-checks that have no machine-readable feed. Copied by hand from each source's own page on the 'checked' date; the daily Action reads this file (keep-last-good: if it can't be read, yesterday's copy in data/raw.json is kept). Edit by hand and update 'checked' when a source publishes new values. Values only, exactly as published; nothing is averaged or adjusted.

mercor.name: APEX-Agents (Mercor)
mercor.metric: share of tasks fully passed on the first try (%)
mercor.note: The leaderboard page shows these models; several run settings of one model = its best run counts (Gemini 4 Neon: xHigh 82.9, High 82.7). The page states no reuse license.

designarena.name: DesignArena
designarena.note: Cross-check only: each board's #1 is compared with the main test's #1 (agree / disagree). No scores are used. The site states no reuse license. Video boards: the #1 as shown on each board page (page update time in UTC).
